turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll type END MEETING on its own line, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Thank you for seeing me, but I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about this zero from the online gradebook, in the middle of your class. Who decided to enter it, and why did nobody call me first?
I'm not here to be thanked, Hale. Who entered the zero, and why was I not called before it went into the gradebook?
Owen is a great kid. Really bright, one of my favourites.
Don't manage me. Owen found out his mark from his phone, in front of his class. Did anyone call me before that happened, yes or no?
I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding.
A misunderstanding is a word for something that's been checked. What did you check before you gave him a zero?
So can we agree he's a good student?
I'm not agreeing to anything yet, Hale. You haven't answered my question about the call. Who decided, and when?
